subject: wardrobe
name: 衣柜
label: 双门小衣柜
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One rounded-top wardrobe front view with two large doors and two round knobs.
A well-proportioned original picture-book object. Structural connections and perspective must be coherent. Simple empty surfaces, no carving, woodgrain, stitches, fabric texture, gray wash, shadows or decorative motifs. No extra room scenery. Entire silhouette centered within clear margins.
